items.title: Delhi High Court sets aside TERI ICC report against RK Pachauri in sexual harassment case; orders fresh probe
items.summary: The Delhi High Court has set aside the sexual harassment findings arrived at by the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) of The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI) against its former Director General RK Pachauri. Pachauri, also the former chairperson of the United Nations’ (UN) Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), faced allegations of sexual harassment from a woman research assistant at TERI in February 2015. An internal inquiry by the ICC found him guilty of sexual harassment in May 2015. Pachauri denied the allegations and challenged the findings before the Industrial Tribunal, which upheld the findings. He died in February 2020. His legal representatives subsequently approached the High Court challenging both the ICC report and the Industrial Tribunal's decision. In his order passed on November 17, Justice Amit Mahajan held that the ICC lacked jurisdiction to investigate the complaint against Pachauri as he fell within the definition of an 'employer' under the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013.
